row.title: PATCH-EDIT-1: the executor shows the named files and takes find-and-replace edits
row.body: Measured 2026-11-20: three runs on Q-CLAIM-reply-promise rewrote site/worker.js from about 1,150 lines to 45, 32 and 51 lines and failed the ELISION-1 shrink guard each time. Cause: the prompt held file names only and the reply format asked for whole files. Fixed in code: foundation/executor.py file_context puts the named files in the prompt (whole under 9,000 characters, an excerpt otherwise) and foundation/agents.py apply_edit places EDIT blocks exactly or unambiguously; tests/foundation/test_dispose.py PatchEdit passes 6 tests.
